title: 第23章 比斗第24章 最好的三哥
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
她的头上出现两只狐耳，臀部长出一条毛茸茸的火红色尾巴，显然她的武魂是一只狐狸。
肖媚手上利爪，直朝宁苒苒袭去。
宁苒苒也亮出了自己的魂环，一黄一紫一黑，很明显这是一个万年魂环。
竟然是万年魂环！
全场哗然，第二个魂环就是千年魂环的那是见都没见过，更别提第三个魂环竟然是万年的魂环了，简直就是震惊世人。
台下的唐三等人也是被吓了一跳，这还是宁苒苒第一次亮出了自己的第三魂环，要知道之前挑战赵无极时，宁苒苒可是从始至终都没亮出过自己的第三魂环，所以大家也是今天第一次得见。
朱竹清的眼睛亮晶晶的，那是一种对于强者的崇拜。
奥斯卡咋舌：“苒苒！
她，她的魂环……”
宁荣荣与有荣焉的点点头：“我妹妹，厉害吧！
等着瞧吧，以后令你们大跌眼睛的事还多着呢。”
肖媚瞳孔震惊！
怎么可能？众所周知，魂师的第二魂环年限在四百年到七百年之间，但是现在的这一幕却打破了她以往的认知。
肖媚：“第一魂技，魅惑之眼！”
她的眼睛变得一片血红，手中想借宁苒苒被迷惑的瞬间抓向她。
宁苒苒嘴角轻勾：“第一魂技，寒冰之焰。”
密集的冰刃直直的射向肖媚，肖媚凭着身法躲过，身子也因此后退，身体在半空几乎是贴着冰刃过去的，就在她以为自己躲过的刹那，冰刃开始接二连三的爆炸开来，完全没想到冰刃之下还裹挟着火焰，怎么回事？水火为什么可以相融？！
刚开场第一回合，肖媚就受了不小的轻伤，原本干净的衣服变的乌漆麻黑，东一块西一块。
肖媚盯着宁苒苒，她没想到对方竟然完全不受她魅惑的影响，要知道，她的这个魂技连魂宗都有可能一不小心会中招，眼前这个小丫头不过才三十一级！
这恰恰说明了眼前之人的深不可测，一时之间肖媚处于下风。

咬咬牙，肖媚：“第二魂技，粉枝流媚。”
巨大的粉色雾气以肖媚为中心开始扩散，场上很快就布满了这诡异的粉雾。
看到这一幕，唐三的心悬了起来。
肖媚勾起嘴角，胜券在握：“小丫头，认输吧。
我的粉枝流媚沾之便会浑身无力，会令你短暂失去行动能力。
我的粉雾弥漫的速度极快，你逃不掉的！”
“是嘛……”
宁苒苒一跃而起：“第三魂技，风卷残龙。”
五个巨大的龙卷风出现，宁苒苒手一挥，四散开来，将那粉雾卷起，巨大的吸力之下，粉雾被牢牢裹挟在龙卷风里。
台上瞬间再无一丝粉色雾气。
肖媚瞪大眼睛，就这么一愣神的功夫，宁苒苒双手结印：“去！”
五个龙卷风合为一体，看着更大了。
它们卷向肖媚，夹杂着粉雾的龙卷风笼罩了肖媚，等到龙卷风消散，肖媚已经支持不住半跪在地上，她浑身无力。
“我……认输。”
content_en:
Two fox ears appeared on her head, and a fluffy fiery red tail sprouted from her hip. It was obvious that her martial spirit was that of a fox.
Xiao Mei's sharp claws struck straight at Ning Ranran.
Ning Ranran also showed off her soul ring, one yellow, one purple and one black. It was obvious that this was a ten thousand year soul ring.
It turned out to be a ten thousand year soul ring!
The whole place was in an uproar. The second soul ring was a thousand-year soul ring, which had never been seen before, let alone the third soul ring, which was a ten-thousand-year soul ring. It was simply shocking to the world.
Tang San and others in the audience were also shocked. This was the first time that Ning Ranran showed his third soul ring. You must know that when he challenged Zhao Wuji before, Ning Ranran never showed his third soul ring from beginning to end, so it was also the first time for everyone to see it today.
Zhu Zhuqing's eyes were shining, showing his admiration for the strong.
Oscar was speechless: "Ran Ran!
She, her soul ring..."
Ning Rongrong and Yourong nodded: "My sister, you must be amazing!
Just wait and see, there will be many things that will surprise you in the future. "
Xiao Mei's pupils were shocked!
How is it possible? As we all know, the age of a soul master's second soul ring is between four hundred and seven hundred years, but this scene now broke her previous understanding.
Xiao Mei: "The first soul skill, Charming Eyes!"
Her eyes turned blood red, and her hands tried to grab Ning Ranran while she was confused.
Ning Ranran's lips curled up slightly: "The first soul skill, Ice Flame."
The dense ice blades shot straight at Xiao Mei. Xiao Mei used her body skills to dodge, and her body retreated. Her body was almost close to the ice blade in mid-air. Just when she thought she had escaped, the ice blades began to explode one after another. She did not expect that there was still flame under the ice blade. What happened? Why can water and fire blend together? !
In the first round, Xiao Mei suffered quite a few minor injuries, and her originally clean clothes turned pitch black with patches here and there.
Xiao Mei stared at Ning Ranran. She didn't expect that the other party was completely unaffected by her charm. You must know that even the Soul Sect may accidentally fall into this soul skill of hers. The little girl in front of her is only level 31!
This just shows that the person in front of her is unfathomable, and Xiao Mei is at a disadvantage for a moment.
Gritting her teeth, Xiao Mei said: "The second soul skill, Pink Branches Flowing Mei."
The huge pink mist began to spread with Xiao Mei as the center, and the place was soon filled with this weird pink mist.
Seeing this scene, Tang San's heart skipped a beat.
Xiao Mei raised her lips, knowing she had a chance to win: "Little girl, just admit defeat.
If you touch my pink branches, your whole body will be weak, and you will be temporarily incapacitated.
My pink mist fills the air very quickly, you can't escape! "
"Yeah..."
Ning Ranran jumped up and said: "The third soul skill, Wind Rolling Broken Dragon."
Five huge tornadoes appeared. Ning Ranran waved his hand and spread out, rolling up the powder mist. Under the huge suction force, the powder mist was tightly wrapped in the tornado.
There was no trace of pink mist on the stage.
Xiao Mei's eyes widened, and for a moment, Ning Ranran formed a seal with her hands: "Go!"
The five tornadoes merged into one and looked even bigger.
They rolled towards Xiao Mei, and the tornado mixed with pink mist enveloped Xiao Mei. When the tornado dissipated, Xiao Mei could no longer hold up and half-knelt on the ground, her whole body was weak.
"I... give up."
